title: Print a Pyramid (stdin)

docs.title: Strings and Characters — Initializing an Empty String

hints: `String(repeating:count:)` builds runs of the same character.
Row `i` has `h - i` spaces and `2i - 1` stars — no trailing spaces.
`print(String(repeating: " ", count: h - i) + String(repeating: "*", count: 2 * i - 1))`.
